change: Moved biceps (Biceps Brachii) from primary to secondary. Per CLAUDE.md pull classification rules, biceps is a secondary on lat pulldowns, not a co-primary. Latissimus Dorsi remains the sole primary. All other secondaries (Rhomboids, Lower Traps, Rotator Cuff, Wrist Flexors) confirmed correct and retained.

Removed Wrist Flexors from secondary. A pronated-grip (reverse) curl does not meaningfully recruit the wrist flexors — the dominant muscles are the brachioradialis and brachialis (mapped to forearms->Wrist Extensors as the closest allowed encoding) and biceps brachii. EMG studies confirm brachioradialis is primary elbow flexor with pronated grip. Secondary is now empty as no other allowed-list muscle is meaningfully engaged beyond the two primaries.

Added oblique (External Obliques, Internal Obliques) to secondary — this is a unilateral exercise and per CLAUDE.md rules, unilateral movements add anti-rotation oblique stabilization as secondary. Also expanded Calves entry to include Gastrocnemius Lateral alongside Gastrocnemius Medial and Soleus for complete gastrocnemius representation during stance stabilization.

Removed Upper Traps from the mid back primary group. The reverse fly involves scapular retraction, which is driven by rhomboids and middle trapezius (encoded as Lower Traps in the allowed list). Upper Traps are associated with scapular elevation and are not a primary mover in this horizontal abduction movement. Rhomboids and Lower Traps retained in primary mid back entry. All other values confirmed correct.

No changes made. Primary (Anterior Deltoids) and secondary (Clavicular Head + Sternal Head, Biceps Brachii) confirmed correct by web search — this stretch targets the anterior deltoid and pectorals primarily, with biceps brachii as secondary. Category Bodyweight, equipment other, trackingMode timed all confirmed appropriate for a static stretch performed against a surface.
